title: get_ledger_entries and get_full_ledger_entries drop the extXdr field, so the sponsor of a ledger entry cannot be read

target.versions_affected: 30.0.0 (main 316aabc8 differs from the tag only in a workflow file; lower bound not established); also seen through stellar-cli 30.0.1 (stellar ledger entry fetch)

severity_basis: LedgerEntryResult and FullLedgerEntry have no field for extXdr and serde drops unknown fields, so get_ledger_entries, get_full_ledger_entries and stellar ledger entry fetch (even --output xdr, documented as the original RPC output) give no way to see an entry's LedgerEntryExt and so its sponsoringId (CAP-33). No value is decoded wrongly (the issue states impact low).

entries.expected: the parsed getLedgerEntries result carries the entry's LedgerEntryExt when the server sends extXdr
entries.observed: No corpus entry drives the RPC client. By hand on stellar-rpc-client 30.0.0 with a localhost server answering in the shape stellar-rpc builds for a sponsored account: neither the get_ledger_entries nor the get_full_ledger_entries result has the extension. With stellar-cli 30.0.1 against stellar-rpc 30 on a local standalone network, stellar ledger entry fetch --output xdr for an account created inside a sponsoring block omits the extXdr the raw response holds.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's standalone program on stellar-rpc-client 30.0.0, with a localhost server: the serialized get_ledger_entries entry has key, xdr and lastModifiedLedgerSeq, and the get_full_ledger_entries entry has key, val and lastModifiedLedgerSeq; extXdr, which holds the sponsor GCATS5YO…, is dropped. stellar ledger entry fetch account --output xdr (CLI 30.0.1) omits the extXdr naming the sponsor GBQL4M27….
evidence.expected_basis: stellar-rpc's getLedgerEntries returns extXdr, the base64 LedgerEntryExt of the entry, since v23.0.0; LedgerEntryExt v1 carries sponsoringId (CAP-33).

reproduction.method: The runs the issue reports, made on stellar-rpc-client 30.0.0 and stellar-cli 30.0.1 before filing on 2026-11-19: neither result has the extension.

queries: stellar/rs-stellar-rpc-client: every issue and pull request, open and closed
stellar/stellar-cli: every issue and pull request about ledger entry fetch or extXdr

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/rs-stellar-rpc-client/issues/124; this record restates the public issue.
